messages.author: 8f6c8b880cc6347c
messages.subject: Latent Instrument Variable and LAVAAN
parts:
Hello,

I recently came across a reviewer requesting we address the potential for endogeneity in our SEM. The LIV method was recommended by a colleague but not sure if anyone has attempted to use this with LAVAAN or how it might work with an SEM in general. I would appreciate in help with this.

Best,

KT Manis
Texas Tech University

messages.author: 5abdb409f213d464
messages.subject: Re: Latent Instrument Variable and LAVAAN
parts:

All, sorry, this is a silly objection. A sem is  a full causal model with explicit modeling of causal relations among all included variables. This kind of concern is legitimate for multiple regression with no causal model but that is not the case here.

University of Cape Town
